BSF block 260 (grass_g1024_s3_k32): digit tokens in the block's 3 coordinates

Each point is one digit token where the block fires, coloured by the units digit (light = 0, dark = 9); axes are the block's principal axes over digit tokens (variance 59% / 41% / 0%). The line joins per-digit means in order 0→9. Hover for the text context; the measured token is in [brackets].

Click a digit in the legend to hide/show it; double-click to isolate.
